#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

struct Tuple {
    long d;
    int x, y, z;
    Tuple(long d, int x, int y, int z) : d(d), x(x), y(y), z(z) {}
};

class CGregAndFriends {
public:
    long mod = 1000000007;
    long INF = (long)1e18 + 1;
    vector<vector<long>> nCr;
    vector<vector<vector<long>>> dist, dp;
    int firstCount, secondCount;
    int maxWeight;

    long f(long p, int a, int b, int c, int d) {
        p *= nCr[a][b];
        p %= mod;
        p *= nCr[c][d];
        p %= mod;
        return p;
    }

    void solve() {
        int n;
        cin >> n >> maxWeight;
        firstCount = 0;
        secondCount = 0;

        nCr.assign(100, vector<long>(100, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
                if (j == 0 || j == i)
                    nCr[i][j] = 1;
                else
                    nCr[i][j] = (nCr[i - 1][j] + nCr[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int val;
            cin >> val;
            if (val == 50)
                firstCount++;
            else
                secondCount++;
        }

        dist.assign(200, vector<vector<long>>(200, vector<long>(2, INF)));
        dp.assign(200, vector<vector<long>>(200, vector<long>(2, 0)));

        dist[0][0][0] = 0;
        dp[0][0][0] = 1;

        queue<Tuple> q;
        q.emplace(0, 0, 0, 0);

        while (!q.empty()) {
            Tuple current = q.front();
            q.pop();
            long d = current.d;
            int x = current.x;
            int y = current.y;
            int z = current.z;

            if (z == 0) {
                int remX = firstCount - x;
                int remY = secondCount - y;
                for (int i = 0; i <= remX; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= remY; j++) {
                        if (i + j == 0) continue;
                        if (i * 50 + j * 100 > maxWeight) break;
                        int nx = x + i;
                        int ny = y + j;
                        int nz = z ^ 1;
                        if (dist[nx][ny][nz] >= d + 1) {
                            if (dist[nx][ny][nz] > d + 1) {
                                dist[nx][ny][nz] = d + 1;
                                q.emplace(dist[nx][ny][nz], nx, ny, nz);
                                long val = f(dp[x][y][z], remX, i, remY, j);
                                dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + val) % mod;
                            } else {
                                long val = f(dp[x][y][z], remX, i, remY, j);
                                dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + val) % mod;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                int remX = x;
                int remY = y;
                for (int i = 0; i <= remX; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= remY; j++) {
                        if (i + j == 0) continue;
                        if (i * 50 + j * 100 > maxWeight) break;
                        int nx = x - i;
                        int ny = y - j;
                        int nz = z ^ 1;
                        if (dist[nx][ny][nz] >= d + 1) {
                            if (dist[nx][ny][nz] > d + 1) {
                                dist[nx][ny][nz] = d + 1;
                                q.emplace(dist[nx][ny][nz], nx, ny, nz);
                                long val = f(dp[x][y][z], remX, i, remY, j);
                                dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + val) % mod;
                            } else {
                                long val = f(dp[x][y][z], remX, i, remY, j);
                                dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + val) % mod;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (dist[firstCount][secondCount][1] == INF)
            cout << -1 << "\n";
        else
            cout << dist[firstCount][secondCount][1] << "\n";

        cout << dp[firstCount][secondCount][1] << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    CGregAndFriends solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
